returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the bot user object (id, is_bot, first_name, username, capabilities).

description: Send a text message to a chat.

chat_id.description: The id of the target chat.

text.description: The text of the message to send.

reply_to_message_id.description: Optional id of the message being replied to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the formatted message object; on failure (chat not found), output contains an error message.

description: Send a photo to a chat with an optional caption.

chat_id.description: The id of the target chat.

photo.description: The file id or reference of the photo to send.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the formatted message object with a photo array; on failure (chat not found), output contains an error message.

description: Edit the text of an existing message in a chat.

chat_id.description: The id of the chat containing the message.

message_id.description: The id of the message to edit.

text.description: The new text for the message.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the edited message object (with edit_date); on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a message from a chat.

chat_id.description: The id of the chat containing the message.

message_id.description: The id of the message to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is true; on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get information about a chat by its id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the chat object; on failure (chat not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the membership status of a user in a chat.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the user and their status; on failure (chat or user not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get pending updates (messages) for the bot, optionally starting from an offset.

limit.description: Maximum number of updates to return (default 100).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of update objects each wrapping a message.
